LanguageData.LP_RedDragon.label: red dragon
LanguageData.LP_RedDragon.description: The mightiest and greediest of the chromatic dragons. Red dragons live in volcanoes and high mountains, sleep on mountains of gold and breathe fire. They are arrogant and cruel, believing all the treasure in the world rightfully belongs to them.\n\nTrue dragons are intelligent, can speak and live for thousands of years. They have legendary resistance, legendary actions and a frightful presence; they die when they fall and never surrender.

LanguageData.LP_BlueDragon.label: blue dragon
LanguageData.LP_BlueDragon.description: Master of deserts and wastes. Blue dragons can burrow under the sand, bursting from below to ambush prey, and breathe a straight line of lightning. They are vain and orderly, and like to command dragon cultists.\n\nTrue dragons are intelligent, can speak and live for thousands of years. They have legendary resistance, legendary actions and a frightful presence; they die when they fall and never surrender.

LanguageData.LP_GreenDragon.label: green dragon
LanguageData.LP_GreenDragon.description: The most cunning dragon of the forests. Green dragons breathe poison gas, are masters of lies and charm, and can move stealthily through water. They would rather have prey walk into the lair by itself.\n\nTrue dragons are intelligent, can speak and live for thousands of years. They have legendary resistance, legendary actions and a frightful presence; they die when they fall and never surrender.

LanguageData.LP_BlackDragon.label: black dragon
LanguageData.LP_BlackDragon.description: The most venomous dragon of the swamps. A black dragon's skull-like face is covered in corrosion scars, and it breathes a line of acid that can dissolve armor. Its lairs are always pitch dark.\n\nTrue dragons are intelligent, can speak and live for thousands of years. They have legendary resistance, legendary actions and a frightful presence; they die when they fall and never surrender.

LanguageData.LP_WhiteDragon.label: white dragon
LanguageData.LP_WhiteDragon.description: The smallest and most savage of the chromatic dragons. White dragons live on ice fields and glaciers, breathe ice, disdain bargaining and pounce on prey on sight.\n\nTrue dragons are intelligent, can speak and live for thousands of years. They have legendary resistance, legendary actions and a frightful presence; they die when they fall and never surrender.
